cohort: 287 women with intrauterine fetal death admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Government Medical College and Rajindra Hospital, Patiala, Punjab, India, from February 2020 to January 2021, with the diagnosis of intrauterine foetal death after 20 weeks of gestation
finding: The ReCoDe system was able to explain the cause of stillbirth in 81.89% of cases, with hypertensive disorders (31.71%) and fetal growth restriction (16.02%) being the most common causes.
